reviews.text:
Thank you so much, Valerie, for your 5-star rating! We look forward to welcoming you back to Toutou Chic Paris 17 for your next dog grooming appointment in Paris 17.
The Toutou Chic Paris 17 Team

As an American who moved to Paris, one of the hardest things was finding a trustworthy and skilled groomer, and I’m so lucky to have found this place! They always make sure to groom my dog exactly as I’ve explained, and they’re incredibly patient with him (because I know he can be a little dramatic).

I travel across the city just to bring my dog here, and I’ll continue to do so. Highly recommend! ❤️
Thank you so much, Alice, for these 5 stars! We look forward to seeing you again soon at Toutou Chic Paris 17 for your next grooming appointment. The Toutou Chic Paris 17 Team
Excellent Dog shop and wonderful management!
Excellent experience!

A fantastic first experience for Miguel, my 10-year-old Shiba Inu!

Booking online was incredibly convenient, and I received very quick answers via WhatsApp, even on a Sunday, to help me choose the most suitable package. I really appreciated that there was absolutely no pressure to buy more, quite the opposite!

Manon took care of Miguel, including his very first nail trim, and everything went perfectly. He came out looking clean and handsome 😊

A lovely team and truly top-notch service. I highly recommend them!

Lovely grooming salon, comfortable sofa to relax on while you wait.
Friendly staff, I left with a few gifts.
My cat got what I asked for and everything went well for him.
See you soon!

The welcome was pleasant and the haircut was decent.

When I booked, I was quoted €80-90 for a scissor cut, with a possible extra charge only if there were any tangles.

In the end: €140, with two detangling sessions and a keratin treatment charged extra, without any prior warning. The hair was soft, admittedly… but the price was anything but!
I find the difference between the quoted price and the final price truly excessive, and especially difficult to justify compared to the prices charged in other salons in West Paris for similar services.
Valeria groomed my little dog perfectly, exactly as I wanted. The only downside was that she doesn't speak French, so communication was minimal.
Valeria spent 3 hours working on Arsène. Incredible patience for a beautiful result! Amazing work! Thank you so much!!! Go ahead and book an appointment with Valeria without hesitation 🙏🏻🙏🏻🐶🐶
Fantastic grooming salon! Everyone is so attentive and our dog always leaves happy.

My little Volt had his first grooming session at Toutou Chic. We were a bit apprehensive about his reaction, but in the end, everything went wonderfully. He came out looking beautiful and happy!

The staff is very pleasant and always smiling! Volt even received a little gift. 🥰

I'll definitely be going back!

This is the second time I've taken my dogs, Spencer and Stanley, and I'm just as satisfied as the first time! The welcome is warm, the team is very professional, my dogs were perfectly groomed, and their care was given with great attention.

They left looking beautiful and relaxed.

Plus, I had the lovely surprise of receiving a beautiful photo of my two dogs, a thoughtful touch that really made my day. It's these little gestures that make all the difference… Honestly, I have absolutely no complaints, it's a true 10/10! I highly recommend them. Thank you again, Valérie and Léa, for your excellent work! 🐶✨

Maria took care of my little Bichon Frise's very first grooming session, and I'm absolutely thrilled! She's not very cooperative, but Maria managed to gain her trust, doing a very professional job. I have to cross all of Paris to get there, as I live on the opposite side of town, but the work is so high quality that I'll go back every time without hesitation.

I have a Pomeranian, and we all know how difficult and trusting it is to find a good groomer who respects the breed and the challenges of coat maintenance. I loved the service; the team is fantastic and incredibly attentive. They welcome you to a spotless environment, and every dog ​​that comes in gets treats and special attention. Thank you for your time and care. I will definitely be back and will recommend them to everyone I know.

One of the best salons in Paris. They are incredibly patient with animals. I take my Bichon Frise, who hates being groomed and is very difficult, and they always manage to calm him down and give him a quality grooming session. 100% recommended!
Madi came out looking absolutely beautiful. The service was excellent; her paws have never looked so lovely. Really happy!

A very professional and attentive team.
My cocker spaniel came out looking as good as new thanks to Maria.
Always a pleasure to take Viennoise to Toutouchic! 3rd time and still just as perfect!
Delighted with the haircut Blandine gave me. She followed the instructions and took great care of Penny. Thank you so much!

I loved it!! 😍 First visit for my little miniature poodle, and I'm thrilled! 🥰

I chose the puppy grooming package with a scissor cut and a treatment.
Everything was explained very clearly before we started, which immediately put me at ease. The team is very welcoming, gentle, and professional.

My dog ​​came out looking gorgeous, exactly as I'd hoped!
You can tell they take their time and love animals.

I highly recommend them and I'll definitely be back!
Great experience; my dog ​​is brand new!

I'm very disappointed with this salon: this is the second time my appointment in the 16th arrondissement has been cancelled on the same day and replaced with a slot in the 17th arrondissement salon at a different time, without any prior consultation. Presenting this as a "solution" when it's imposed upon me is unacceptable. It's unreliable for anyone with a tight schedule.

Fantastic grooming salon!
My dog ​​came out completely white with a shiny coat!

It was wonderful.

And they even gave her a little gift 💝
Thank you, we'll be back!

I've been coming to Toutou Chic with my little dog for a while now. I'm always just as satisfied. The staff are particularly kind and always take excellent care of my dog. The care is top-notch. Jordan, the owner, is lovely and very professional. He knows what he's doing and is very knowledgeable in his field. I highly recommend them.

I've been to all their salons, and the one at number 16 is excellent too. The service is top-notch, they're incredibly professional and responsive; you don't have to wait forever for an appointment. I highly recommend them. My dog ​​looks fantastic, and when there are minor adjustments needed, the groomers are very attentive. I've been going exclusively to them for over a year now.

I'm very satisfied with Toutou Chic! I regularly take my Spitz there and the results are always impeccable. The team is professional, attentive, and perfectly understands the needs of this breed. I trust them completely. I highly recommend them!
My first experience at Toutou Chic and certainly not my last! The team is welcoming, attentive, and very professional. My dog ​​came out looking magnificent. I'm thrilled with the result!
Toutou Chic is a fantastic team! Always a warm welcome, highly professional, and impeccable grooming. As a loyal customer for over a year, I've never been disappointed. I highly recommend them!

Today I took my dog to this spa as per recommendation of a friend. I was 27 mins late to the appointment bcs when copy and pasted the address in the 85€ hold receipt they take from you, it sent me to a different location. I think it’s the same group just a different store. I get there and first they say they will only shower my dog bcs I’m late and they can’t trim him. Then they say only the face and the back then I get mad and ask to just cancel and leave and they said they will take all the money regardless. (Needless to say it doesn’t say this anywhere within a legal disclosure method). The. They say pay more and we will do the full cut. I pick up my dog, they charged me 100€ and they didn’t do the full cut, barely the trim and then tell me is to protect his skin. I complain and the owner text me and first say the extra 15€ charge was bcs my dog had nuts, then bcs I was late and the. He said that he would only refund me 25% bcs the job was done (it wasn’t),
My 6-month-old cocker spaniel had his very first grooming session. Laurine was incredibly gentle and patient with my puppy. He left with a beautiful haircut that perfectly matched my requests.
I found my cat Maritza calm and collected, even though she's usually very shy and timid. Thanks to Gwendeline and Toutou Chic. I'll be back.

I'm surprised by this review!

I'm not taking my dog ​​there anymore.
She's never been properly groomed or washed!
I must have been one of the first customers on Rue Lebon.
One day I just asked for a wash, but the young woman asked if she needed to cut anything.
She had just come from the groomer at the same place about three weeks prior.
I told her to do her best.
She cut three hairs, and I paid full price!
Beyond this kind of behavior, I feel she's never come home well-groomed.
I really don't recommend it!
Great salon for our dogs, welcoming and very professional staff. Highly recommended.

Voyou, our Bichon Frise, had his first appointment! The welcome was lovely!
The grooming was perfect! Voyou didn't want to leave!
I highly recommend this salon.

First visit today for Leroy's first birthday, and I'm absolutely delighted!

The grooming is impeccable, Leroy looks magnificent. The whole team was very welcoming, professional, and kind to him. You can tell they truly love animals and take the time to make them feel comfortable.

A special mention to the manager who thoughtfully gave Leroy a few little gifts for his birthday. It was a lovely gesture and shows how much they care about their clients.

I wholeheartedly recommend this establishment, and Leroy will definitely be back. Thank you again for your kindness and professionalism!

The groomers did a fantastic job with my dog. She received a full service: bath, dry, nail trim, summer cut, and a trim. When I returned home, I found my dog ​​incredibly adorable and happy.

Some of the groomers speak both French and English, which made it easy to explain what I needed.

Their salon was clean, bright, and spacious. I had no worries about leaving my dog ​​in their care.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of my dog.

The female groomers did an amazing job on my pup. She had the full service: a bath, dry, nail trim, summer cut, and a trim. I came back to an amazingly adorable and happy dog.

Some of the groomers speak both French and English, so it was easy to communicate what was needed.

Their facility was clean, bright, and open. I had no worries about leaving my pup with them.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of my pup.

Thank you so much, Karine, for these 5 stars! We look forward to seeing you again at Toutou Chic Paris 17 for your pet's next grooming appointment.

The Toutou Chic Paris 17 Team
Perfect welcome, excellent haircut, my dog ​​was left relaxed, I highly recommend it.

Excellent grooming by Gwendoline, but the rest of the team was rather casual (the shop opened 30 minutes late, causing me to miss a first professional appointment), vague about the end time of the service, and to top it off, no change was given... a shame...

Another wonderful haircut for my Chipie.
The establishment is very clean, the staff are lovely and very professional. Excellent grooming.

Fantastic experience at this groomer! The salon is very clean and the atmosphere is really pleasant. A big thank you to Anna who does a wonderful job with Uki.
We'll definitely be back!
Excellent, the best dog salon in all of Paris!

Stavina and Mailys always take wonderful care of Nuts and Victor; they are gentle and professional. The salon is always very clean. Everyone is very welcoming. The products used are clean. Honestly, I highly recommend it. My dog ​​is like my child, so I take very good care of her. It has become Nuts' favorite place, and we will be going back every three months.

We love TouTou Chic! I was looking for a dog groomer for our mini Aussie last year when we loved to Paris and am so happy I found them. We started off at this location and was thrilled when they opened Little TouTou Chic as it’s closer to me. That said, both locations have taken excellent care of Harvey. His cuts are always great, and I pick him up and he’s refreshed and happy. They put up with my terrible French ;) and are always professional and friendly! 100% recommend! And their website makes it so easy to schedule!

Thank you Toutou Chic for grooming my Shiba Inu.
Clean shop and warm welcome.
While in Paris, I contacted this groomer to take care of Sky, my golden retriever. Excellent grooming and top-notch customer service.
Perfect, thank you for your help.
I was extremely happy with Blandine's service; it was perfect, and Alfie felt reassured. I highly recommend her!
Very satisfied, very warm welcome and thank you to Manon for taking care of Kapi, my big German Shepherd.
Thank you so much Cristina for your 5 stars! We hope to see you again soon at TOUTOU CHIC PARIS 17. See you soon!
High-end grooming salon, impeccable service and workmanship. Loves animals and takes great care of them.

Fantastic grooming salon! We take our cocker spaniel there, and he always comes out looking magnificent!

Plus, the team is very welcoming, truly listens to your wishes, and gives excellent advice.

We always have such a great experience at Toutou Chic. The team is incredibly kind, welcoming, and truly caring with the dogs. You can tell they love what they do, and it shows in how they treat Bobbi every time. We always leave happy and will definitely keep coming back!

A completely successful experience. The salon provides excellent service to its clients with exceptional care and attention. The groomer did a remarkable job on my short-haired Chihuahua. The customer service with the manager, Jordan, was also very satisfactory. I highly recommend this salon and this pet grooming brand.

A huge thank you to Toutouchic salon!
Our dog is quite a difficult client, but the team found an incredible approach thanks to their professionalism, patience, and above all, their love for animals. You can tell they don't just go through the motions—they truly put their heart and soul into it.

The result is simply perfect: the grooming is of very high quality, with meticulous attention to every detail.
We feel completely reassured entrusting our dog to such a caring and competent team. I recommend them without hesitation!

First time at Toutou Chic for us, we received a super warm welcome and Manon the groomer was amazing!!
I'm so happy with the result, thank you so much 🤍
Ornella & Charlotte …
The joy of getting my dog ​​back, so soft, tangle-free, and smelling so good! Thank you for your special attention and for giving him the haircut we love, always with a smile!
Tosca was very well groomed, she looked superb!!!! A very good team, warm, friendly and competent.

I was very satisfied with their service for my 8-month-old cocker spaniel. The welcome was perfect and very pleasant; they followed my instructions to the letter.
I highly recommend them!
